status: Prospective design for new synthetic benchmarks and shuffled-label pipeline controls; real predictor results and physical literature are already known
scope: Validation and delivery of the existing raw K/R-gain score contrast. No arbitrary-rule claim, internal mechanism inference, new clinical test, comparator search, transformed-scale search or new real-data robustness sweep.
score_scale: Unbounded additive synthetic scores; raw released scores for the two-model pipeline control
sign: Cytosolic minus outer K/R-minus-neutral penalty. Negative corresponds to relatively greater outer charge penalty under this specified comparison.

benchmark.alternative_chemistry: Fixed linear offsets from -0.15 to +0.15 in alphabet order; the same offsets in every scenario
benchmark.reference_imbalance: N/Q: 8 cytosolic, 2 outer; A/V: 2 cytosolic, 8 outer in every protein
benchmark.uneven_proteins: Multiply the balanced cell size by 1 + protein_index modulo 4
methods: naive_charge_arm_only: match protein/reference strata but omit the same-site neutral arm
naive_unstratified_paired: subtract within-site arms but omit protein/reference matching
packaged_within_site_stratified: call the retained production gain_contrast and stratum_parts functions
standard_fixed_effects: independent within-stratum regression on within-site penalties, algebraically equivalent to the packaged point estimate
benchmark.truth: Design-weighted expected charge-by-side contrast, computed independently from the generator with mean-zero protein-by-side effects integrated out. The theta signal occurs only on cytosolic K/R alternatives; its outer contribution is zero. Under decay, use the actual weighted cytosolic distance distribution, not the planted amplitude. Layout and distances are fixed across replicates.
benchmark.clustering: A random protein-specific charge-by-side coefficient changes the estimated contrast and creates dependence across reference strata. Shared protein intercepts alone do not validate cluster inference.
benchmark.intervals: Whole-protein percentile resampling. Report coverage against the declared generator target, bias, RMSE, null rejection, direction recovery, power and Monte Carlo uncertainty for every method/scenario.
checks: Deterministic oracle recovery and independent fixed-effects point agreement within 1e-10
Literal-score arm fixtures use different K/R scores, extreme excluded D/E/H scores, a missing introduced variant, partial/absent neutral coverage and charged-reference exclusions
Adding a shared site constraint leaves the paired penalty unchanged
A uniform protein-by-side injected charge effect shifts the estimated contrast by its planted amount

A noisy fixture in every scenario bridges the actual production summarize_parts point/interval to an independent matrix-resampling calculation with identical seeded draws; 25 sampled coefficients also match weighted fixed-effects regression
Report all 28 method/scenario cells; never remove an unfavorable cell
Assess primary coverage with exact binomial tests and Holm correction across seven scenarios; no adjusted p below 0.05 permits only a limited calibration pass for these generators
Primary absolute bias must be below max(0.005, four Monte Carlo standard errors of the mean estimate)

shuffled_label_control.unit: An eligible site with its charged and neutral score arms kept together
shuffled_label_control.shuffle: Membrane-side labels within contributing protein/reference-residue strata, preserving each stratum's cytosolic/outer counts
shuffled_label_control.interpretation: A destructive pipeline negative control, not a causal randomization test of the original observational scores
report: Monte Carlo SE of the mean
shuffled_label_control.finite_population_oracle: E[T]=0; Var(T)=sum_g(w_g*s_g^2)/(sum_g w_g)^2 with w_g=n_c*n_o/n_g and fixed within-stratum sample variance s_g^2
checks: Zero lies in the shuffled central 95% range
Absolute shuffled mean is below max(1e-10, four Monte Carlo SEs from the exact variance)
All stratum side counts are preserved
Independent closed-form shuffle statistic agrees with the production estimator within 1e-10
Empirical variance differs from the exact variance by no more than four asymptotic Gaussian Monte Carlo SEs; report this approximation separately

impact_count.population: Eligible outer sites within ten residues in the same all-uncharged comparison
impact_count.candidate_definition: A K or R variant scores below the mean of measured same-site uncharged alternatives; pooled site status uses mean K/R minus that comparator below zero
impact_count.report: Variant, site and unique-protein counts with denominators and one-versus-two introduced-variant and neutral-arm coverage, for each model. The count population includes all eligible outer sites, including sites outside matched two-sided strata. These are relative score-pattern candidates, not proven biologically reversed variants or clinical errors.

positive_control_rule: No non-charge module is added. Limit the validated claim to the specified membrane K/R-gain comparison; other existing tool charge outputs remain descriptive.
gate0: Assess the distinction from existing fixed-effects statistics, positional/substitution decompositions, biological behavioral tests, protein benchmarks and model interpretability. Never certify priority from a non-exhaustive search.
presentation: One main scientific figure, a precise one-sentence claim, an AI-assisted master draft, a defense guide, a transparent harm-evidence scope and an updated completion record. Only the student can establish personal fluency and final authorship.
protected: Retain previous reports and October 3 rollback. Do not change frozen protocols, reveal Phase D labels, overwrite existing analyses, stage, commit or push. Record new validation separately.
